_finding: The B20 transfer rules are facts with their time, and unreadable is unknown, never open (docs/b20-transfers-tz.md §0.1, §7): an unknown policy id that answers true for everyone, a failed or stale read and a pause that does not decode are unknown; the pause comes first; the state follows isAuthorized and not the shape of the id; the issuer list is said beside the chain; a failed or unread answer is never a change.

mutations.name: a bound id that does not exist is not missing
mutations.expect: FAIL an unknown id answering true for everyone

mutations.name: a missing policy no longer makes the state unknown
mutations.expect: FAIL an unknown id answering true for everyone

mutations.name: a stale reading is taken as current
a failed read is not named
mutations.expect: FAIL a failed read: unknown, read_failed

mutations.name: paused is not a state
mutations.find: if (reading.paused === true) return { ...out, state: 'paused', reason: null }
mutations.expect: FAIL paused on chain: paused, before any other state

mutations.name: a pause that did not decode is read as not paused
mutations.expect: FAIL a pause that did not decode

mutations.name: the receiver scope is not checked for the ordinary wallet
mutations.expect: FAIL the ordinary wallet refused in the receiver scope

mutations.name: a refused venue does not restrict
mutations.expect: FAIL the KyberSwap router refused as executor

mutations.name: an inverted id is read by its shape as allow
mutations.expect: FAIL an inverted allowlist of everyone refuses everyone

mutations.name: a word above 2^64 is taken as an id
mutations.expect: FAIL a word above 2^64 is no policy id

mutations.name: the issuer list is not said beside the chain
mutations.expect: FAIL ...paused on chain and not on the issuer

mutations.name: a failed reading is compared for the alert
mutations.expect: FAIL a failed reading is never compared

mutations.name: an unread answer counts as a change
mutations.find: if (a !== b && a !== null && b !== null)
mutations.expect: FAIL an answer that could not be read is not a change

mutations.name: a venue is refused in a role it does not play
mutations.find: (scopes ? scopes.some((s) => v.scopes && v.scopes[s] === false) : v.allowed === false)
mutations.expect: FAIL a pool refused only as a receiver

mutations.name: a change of the probe wallet carries its address
mutations.find: address: acc.name === 'ordinary_wallet' ? null : acc.address, from: a, to: b })
mutations.replace: address: acc.address, from: a, to: b })
mutations.expect: FAIL a change of the ordinary wallet

mutations.name: the snapshot gives the probe wallet's address
mutations.expect: FAIL the snapshot for health-check: no probe address
